opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage BUSD as an earning platform built around a required 10 BUSD registration payment, split between X3 and X4. It places participants into upline and matrix positions, then ties team-building to achieving good income. The promised returns are presented through claims that X3 doubles an investment, that payments from later positions flow to the participant, and that the structure can produce eleven-times income and rapid earnings. The stated slot amounts and wallet-payment descriptions reinforce a recruitment-based participation-and-return model: entry requires payment, income depends on positions and team formation, and larger returns are represented as following from movement through the structure.
